pages.text: Pillagers are the faction that profited from the fall. Outposts, fortresses and camps hold stolen goods and some Blueprints. Illager Invasion adds new kinds — illusioners, sorcerers, basher, provokers — the longer a raid runs.$(br2)Raids come from Bad Omen; a village with guards and walls holds, one without does not.

Savage & Ravage and Respillaged make outposts and raids worth the fight: loot, totems, and the way to summon a captain when you are ready for one.$(br2)The $(bold)Fortress Illusioner$() holds the trading ledgers. See Blueprints & Recovery.
